name: WallTune
soft_passes: #2 grid — balanced as a unit but biased right; left-to-right unrolling gesture over dead-centre
#3 silhouette — cylinder + rounded rect reads generic in solid black; wallpaper meaning needs colour, roll-mouth carries the shape
#6 palette — one continuous ramp but spans a wide magenta->yellow arc; rich rather than economical
failures: #10 variant robustness — metaphor depends entirely on the multi-hue warm gradient + dark field; collapses in tinted/mono render, no authored Icon Composer layer set. Era-expected miss (Big Sur icon predating Liquid Glass), not a craft defect
light_model: Soft top-down ambient; short soft drop shadows (roll onto card, card onto field); matte paper + matte gradient, no glass specular/refraction. Big Sur baked-shadow lighting, not Liquid Glass environmental.
layer_stack: warm gradient card with soft drop shadow
rolled cream sheet in front, casting soft shadow onto the card
devices: unrolling wallpaper (rolled cream sheet peeling back to reveal a vibrant gradient field — subject-mined literalism)
roll-mouth (magenta ring + dark inner hole selling the cylinder read and a focal pink pop)
vibrant gradient as content, neutral-dark field as stage (UI de-emphasis logic on an icon)
icon/brand palette coherence (wordmark is a mini of this icon; same ramp washes the cover)
rhymes_hint: warm-gradient-on-charcoal object-metaphor Big Sur icons; the paper/scroll/roll tactile-object family; a subject-mined object staged over a saturated gradient screen on a de-emphasised dark ground
notes: Resolution 512x512 = half the 1024 master (macapp.supply web render); micro-shadow softness and any faint specular are estimated, not clean-measured. Corners outside the squircle are baked pure #000000 in the PNG (mask pre-applied by render, not a design layer) — mask discipline still passes. Background is a genuine subtle ramp, not flat: cool charcoal #2A2E35 (faint blue) at top -> warmer near-black #1B1A1A at bottom. Gradient card is diagonal: magenta-pink TL -> gold-yellow BR, brightest bottom-right (decorative content orientation, independent of the icon's top-down shadow lighting). Key synthesis finding: a competent, internally-coherent Big Sur-era icon shipping in the macOS 26 window WITHOUT adopting Liquid Glass layering — evidence for the kit-predicted shipping-app era lag; single #10 failure is era-structural, not craft. Strong committed personality (subject-mining), so reads as designed, not template.
